scientific.integrity: The result follows from a direct RKHS representer identity, a spectral simplex lower bound, pairwise harmonic means, exact rank-two eigenvalues, and a diagonal sharpness construction. The defining RPCholesky first-step expected-residual identity is explicitly credited to prior literature.
limitations: One pivot; finite real PSD kernels of rank at least two with positive diagonal.
Target-oblivious node distribution but optimal target-dependent single quadrature weight.
Minimax expectation of squared RKHS error with unit Euclidean targets; the supremum precedes random-node expectation.
Diagonal sharpness asymptotic in kernel condition number.
No global multi-pivot or high-probability claim.

title: One-pivot RPCholesky is rank-two minimax with a sharp rank-minus-one gap
